verses.text: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise Jehovah, O my soul.

segments.text: Praise ye Jehovah.
Praise Jehovah, O my soul.

verses.text: While I live will I praise Jehovah: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.

segments.text: While I live will I praise Jehovah:
I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.

verses.text: Put not your trust in princes, Nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.

segments.text: Put not your trust in princes,
Nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.

verses.text: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; In that very day his thoughts perish.

segments.text: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth;

verses.text: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, Whose hope is in Jehovah his God:

segments.text: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help,

verses.text: Who made heaven and earth, The sea, and all that in them is; Who keepeth truth for ever;

segments.text: Who made heaven and earth,
The sea, and all that in them is;

verses.text: Who executeth justice for the oppressed; Who giveth food to the hungry. Jehovah looseth the prisoners;

verses.text: Jehovah openeth the eyes of the blind; Jehovah raiseth up them that are bowed down; Jehovah loveth the righteous;

verses.text: Jehovah preserveth the sojourners; He upholdeth the fatherless and widow; But the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.

verses.text: Jehovah will reign for ever, Thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye Jehovah.
